## TL;DR

A running close-out attempt now writes its own progress log and keeps its step, host and
last-progress time on the job record. `GET /api/tasks/<id>/integration-job` returns them,
and the pipeline snapshot carries them to the card, status bar and drawer. A retry shows
the reason the attempt it replaced failed, in the copy tooltip. A stopped writer is flagged
as possibly stuck. This round merged main, which had moved 464 commits, including #1272.
Its snapshot restructure conflicted with this change, and I re-applied the progress fields
onto main's version.

## Work and rationale

The integration log was only written when a gate check failed, so a job validating for 55
minutes looked the same as a hung one. `src/server/close-out-progress.ts` adds a
`CloseOutProgressRecorder`, which the orchestrator creates for each `processJob` run. It:

- Appends to `.repoos/logs/integration/<id>-attempt-<n>.log`: a start line, one line per
  step change, a heartbeat at least every 15 seconds, and an end line that names the outcome.
- Polls the live remote run every 5 seconds for its host and stage. The remote-run registry
  already records both, so no new callbacks went through the remote pool.
- Persists `step`, `host`, `lastProgressAt` and `progressLogPath` to the job record, scoped to
  the attempt by the existing `expectedAttempt` guard. `progressWritable` refuses writes to a
  `done` or `failed` record.

The orchestrator reports local steps through one `reportStep` helper, a no-op without a
recorder. `processJob` wraps the unchanged body, now named `runJobPhases`. A step or host change
calls `onAttemptProgress`, which `server.ts` wires to `emitIntegration()`, so the UI does not
wait for the next stage event.

Design choices a reviewer should check:

- **Heartbeat, not stage events, drives "alive".** The 5-second stage heartbeat only runs
  inside long stages, so it cannot prove liveness across sync or the queue wait.
- **Stale means the writer stopped.** `progressStale` is set when the last write is 90 seconds
  old on an active attempt. A quiet remote test run still heartbeats and is not flagged.
- **Retries.** `enqueue` already makes a new attempt generation when a failed job is
  re-enqueued. `previousFailure` (attempt, reason, failedAt) is set only when the replaced
  record was `failed`. A cancel does not set it.
- **Copy.** `integrationRetryNote` builds "Attempt 2 — attempt 1 failed: <first line>", and
  `integrationActiveCopy` appends it to the title. The card, status bar and drawer all use that
  helper. Labels are unchanged when a job has no step, host or attempt.

## Merge with main (review round 3)

The only real conflict was `src/server/integration-status.ts`. Main's version returns
`active: null` until a job starts, and its body moved the early return below the queue fields.
I kept main's body and re-applied this change's pieces: the `latestIso` merge of the stage and
progress timestamps, and the `progressStale` flag, judged against the same `at` clock. The
`active` fields (`attempt`, `step`, `host`, `progressStale`, `previousFailure`) merged cleanly.
The task file took main's copy, as AGENTS.md asks. The snapshot, progress, job, copy and
close-out timer tests pass together: 113, 115, 121 and 123 tests in four runs.

Review round 2 also noted that a job waiting in the orchestrator queue has no running attempt,
so its `step` is null. The doc now says so. A remote run's `queued for host slot` appears only
once the run is queued or locked on a runner.

## Approaches tried

I first considered reusing `<id>-<checkAttempt>.log`. That name holds the full transcript of a
failed gate run (#0428), so the attempt-scoped name `<id>-attempt-<n>.log` keeps the two apart.

## Challenges and blockers

- Earlier gate runs failed on unrelated timing-sensitive tests. The layout test in
  `checks-live-run-responsive` waited a fixed 150 ms before measuring. On a loaded shared runner
  that raced the render. I replaced both sleeps with `settledLayout`, which measures until two
  consecutive reports agree and still asserts the last report if the layout never settles.
- One gate run failed on the rendered contrast audit, on the Settings page's clear-light theme.
  That run also had a runner infra failure. The same code passed the full gate on rerun, and no
  file in this diff touches Settings or theme CSS.

## Key learnings

- `readJob` copies job fields one by one, so a new job field not added there is silently
  dropped on read. The round-trip test pins each field.
- The attempt generation is the right key for a log file and for "is this a retry?". The
  per-check counter goes up per gate run, so it is not an attempt identity.
- A snapshot change on main can move the code this branch edits. Re-applying the change onto
  main's body, rather than resolving the conflict by picking one side, kept both behaviours.

## Not done in this change

- `done/total` test progress: the remote runner does not stream a total.
- The suggested screenshot of a stale attempt-2 state. It needs a new fixture state registered in
  four places, and it was a suggestion, not a required fix. Visual evidence is covered by copy
  tests only.
- `previousFailure` persists on a `done` record. It is harmless, since the snapshot only
  surfaces active jobs.
- The recorder keeps heartbeating the last remote step after a remote run ends, until the next
  local step overwrites it. This is log-only and harmless.
